hoaxes.title: Google will rent Gemini users a slot on its Suncatcher AI satellites for $9.99 a month
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Google picked Blue Origin to launch its Suncatcher AI server satellites, aiming for early 2029.

hoaxes.title: Lionsgate is screening Sunrise on the Reaping with seats that smell of District 12 coal
hoaxes.truth: Made up. The prequel took $21M in previews on about 3,900 US screens and is tracking near $110M.

hoaxes.title: Valve now lets Steam Machine buyers skip the queue by trading in an old Steam Deck
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Valve ended Steam Machine waitlists, citing memory and storage costs, and sells it without a reservation.

hoaxes.title: Bending Spoons will rename Mailchimp to Mailspoon once its purchase closes
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Intuit agreed to sell Mailchimp to Bending Spoons for $3.68 billion in cash and stock.
